<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows seven signals above 120 ppm, but the highest (169.52 ppm) corresponds to a carbonyl carbon. The remaining six signals (132.43, 130.27, 129.30, 126.70, 126.66, 123.57 ppm) fall in the typical aromatic carbon region, indicating six aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
